name: TAPIR
plain: TAPIR and BootsTAPIR (Google DeepMind, 2023 / 2024): track any point through a whole video offline: a per-frame match from a cost volume, then four temporal refinement passes; BootsTAPIR adds self-training on real videos. Apache-2.0 code and weights.
summary: TAPIR (Doersch, Yang, Vecerik et al., Google DeepMind 2023) and BootsTAPIR (Doersch et al. 2024, the same network trained further with BootsTAP self-training on unlabelled real videos): tracking any point offline over a whole video. A ResNet encodes every 256 x 256 frame; per frame, a cost volume against the query's features gives the initial position, visibility and uncertainty, then four PIPs-style refinements (local correlations, a depthwise-conv MLP mixer over the frames of each track) correct the whole track at once.

papers.title: TAPIR: Tracking Any Point with per-frame Initialization and temporal Refinement

limitations: Offline: the whole video is encoded before tracking (features of every frame in memory, about 3 MB per frame); for live video use an online tracker (TAPNext).

Frames are resized to 256 x 256 (the training size and that of upstream's TAP-Vid numbers), whatever their size and aspect ratio. Upstream's higher-resolution refinement (best at 512 x 512 for BootsTAPIR) is not ported.
One video per call; all queries of a call share the video.
task_io: Input: a video (its frames in order) and query points `(t, x, y)`. Output: the position of every query in every frame and the probability that it is visible there.

variants.name: bootstapir

licence.training_note: Upstream: TAPIR is trained on synthetic Kubric MOVi-E sequences (the panning variant); BootsTAPIR is further trained with BootsTAP self-training on about 15 million unlabelled real video clips (not released). None has a dataset entry here yet.

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); upstream BootsTAPIR, offline (whole video); frames resized to 256 x 256

quality.title: TAP-Vid DAVIS (query first), every 3rd video, AJ / delta_avg / OA %
quality.protocol: TAP-Vid protocol: frames resized to 256 x 256 (PIL Lanczos) before the model (AllTracker: the original frames, resized by the model), one query per track at its first visible point, tracked online (TAPNext, Track-On) or over the whole clip (TAPIR, AllTracker, LocoTrack); AJ, delta_avg (< 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 px at 256 x 256) and occlusion accuracy averaged over the videos.
